notes: Initial Schedule TO-I by a non-listed BDC for its quarterly share-repurchase-programme tender. Price is NAV per share as of May 31, 2021 (struck after the filing date); price_pct_nav left null because the filing states 'equal to NAV', not a percent. The 390,941 share count is an estimate dependent on the final price (example price $7.28 using Dec 31, 2020 NAV); it equals the shares purchasable with 90% of DRIP proceeds from the April 1, 2021 dividend. Odd-lot holders (<100 shares) get priority before proration. No board recommendation either way. Section 3 conditions also include violation-of-law, credit-limitation and war/calamity items; mapped to legal_injunction, market_disruption and board_discretion. Shares are not exchange-listed (no ticker printed). The tender quote doc_seq 2 for text in the Offer to Purchase exhibit.
